verdict.rationale: Viam documents access control as part of Fleet Management, and its fleet API is described as letting you 'manage permissions and authorization' across organizations, locations, and machines. Individual machines can also enforce per-resource, per-method restrictions via `user_permissions` in their config. The evidence never describes named roles or how command, configure, and view rights are separated, so only the general capability is shown. Missing for 10: documented role definitions (e.g. operator/viewer/admin), explicit separation of command vs configure vs view rights per robot, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can control with roles and permissions who is allowed to command, configure, or view each robot

citations.quote: create and manage organizations, locations, and individual machines; manage permissions and authorization
Machines can optionally enforce per-resource, per-method restrictions through `user_permissions` in the machine's JSON config
Fleet Management: Remote monitoring, access control, and OTA updates
